title: Exodus details written by someone living in New Kingdom Egypt

tellings.quote: uh the the details that are in the Exodus story when you're looking back could have only been written by somebody who was alive in Egypt during the time of the Exodus,

plain: The details in the Exodus story, the Bible's account of the Israelites leaving Egypt, could only have been written by someone living in Egypt at that time. The researcher Luke Caverns makes this argument himself, without naming a source. If true, it would mean the story is an eyewitness-era record and not a later invention.
